[quote=norrhollow;58831361]"Details?... well, nothing you haven't heard before." Ostman said, her tone slowly raising itself to a blanketing bellow. "The Commonwealth of High Albany is one of the most powerful nations in Vespuria today, and yet it knows not what to do with its own capabilities. I am sure that Thýven presents itself as the same on Elseyr."

The Minister raised herself from her seat and turned to a large projection on the screen, which would load up a map of the nations overlooking the White Sea.

"Therefore, the Commonwealth proposes that we join ourselves together in a peaceable alliance, in the name of collective security but also collective action. Unlike THEP, we do not believe in enforcing costly conflicts on the other side of Erene. We only mandate one thing, that the White Sea remain in our hands and not in the hands of these new powers that seem to be springing up left, right, and center."

The Albic delegation murmured as Ostman flicked through the slides of the projection, listing down the specifics. Collective security, equipment standardization, intelligence-sharing, crisis response, peacekeeping, it was all included in their overarching framework. However, one thing would stick out from among the provisions of the alliance: The concept of joint action, that wars must be fought by the alliance under the alliance's own flag, not under the flag of its member nations.

"I'm sure the more conservative members of your government may be reluctant to accept this aspect of the alliance, Your Majesty." Ostman cautioned. "And yet, we believe it'll be most pertinent for the alliance to fight as a single, cohesive unit. We're in the middle of a new decade now, and we must ensure that every single element in our military capabilities is subsumed into a unified system. You've seen THEP's disjointed and fragmentary sorties against Sal-Baliz territory. That alone will not protect our interests in the White Sea."[/quote]

Mij Drs nodded, "I think I can, or we can, agree to this, the security of the White Sea is essential as it is a key trade route and a potential bargaining chip in conflicts, given the fact that we could or can impose peace upon any war by merely threatening to cut the lifeline of trade." she stated "I will have the Secretary General of the National Defense Force be made aware of this decision. And Frankly, if anything the conservatives should be pleased with fighting under the flag of the alliance, it means that if a war starts, they don't have to justify to the citizens sending their boys to fight a war," she stated dryly.

[b]The second round of bombings[/b]
Purple squadron swiftly took off from äilo airbase at 7:02pm, slightly delayed, but not enough to jeopardise the mission. They made their way over to Sal-Balis territory once again, but after learning of their missile strikes, took more caution to now be detected. They flew high, but had to get lower in order to drop the bombs accurately. Once they had descended, the Sal-Baliz were quick to react. Missiles erupted from below leaving huge smoking trails behind. Purple 2 narrowly dodged the first barrage of missile. Purple one gave the order to begin dropping bombs. Target the missile launchers, get them disabled! they ordered. In an instant two of the five missile launchers were gone. The second round of missiles came and this time purple squadron wasnt so lucky. Two of the missiles locked into purple 3. The team tried to warn them, but it was too late. *BOOM* the jet rapidly descended from the clouds in a burning mess. The rest of the incoming missiles were destroyed by the team and the last of the bombs were dropped. The bombs hit two military storage units, but one of the bombs failed to explode, so only one unit was fully destroyed. What was left of the group turned back around and headed back to base, pained by the loss of their team mate. On the way back, they were given orders to instead land on an aircraft carrier in the Shamat sea. Total estimated casualties, including purple three are at 57.
